name: Jibanyan
description: A cat Yo-kai known for his energetic personality.

name: Komasan
description: A country bumpkin Yo-kai who is fascinated by city life.

name: Whisper
description: Nate's ghostly butler Yo-kai, who guides him on his Yo-kai adventures and explains how the Yo-kai world works.

name: Komajiro
description: Komasan's younger brother, who adjusts to city life much more easily than his sibling.

name: Hungramps
description: A gruff old Yo-kai who makes people hungry, then eats everything in sight.

name: Noway
description: A Yo-kai who makes people say 'no way' to everything.

name: Walkappa
description: A kappa Yo-kai who makes people put their foot in their mouth or say embarrassing things.

name: Tattletell
description: A gossip Yo-kai who makes people blurt out secrets they meant to keep.

name: Wazzat
description: A Yo-kai that makes people forget things, leaving them wondering what they were about to do.

name: Insomni
description: A Yo-kai whose presence keeps people awake all night.
